_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Reuse Management Report (ReMR)
summary: Provides information about existing software products intended to be reused as-is or modified as part of the delivered operational software, including the current status of related reuse activities and alternative approaches.
applicable_forms:
Worksheet Questions for Reused As-is/Modified Software
Worksheet Questions for COTS/GOTS Software
use_relationship:
The Reuse Management Report (ReMR) provides information about existing software products intended to be reused as-is or modified as part of the delivered operational software.  The report also provides the acquirer insight into the current status of the activities associated with the reuse of these products as compared to the planned activities, and alternative approaches.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work tasks described in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain the following:

children.title: Executive Summary
children.content: This section shall identify and briefly describe all software products that will be reused as-is or modified (existing software requiring change) and integrated into the delivered operational software.  Both commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and government off-the-shelf (GOTS) shall be included.

children.title: Current Status
children.content: This section shall present the current status of the software reuse activities compared to the contractor's planned activities.  Status shall include progress made and accomplishments for the engineering and management activities for each software reuse product.

children.title: Variance
children.content: This section shall identify any activities where work is not progressing in accordance with the plans and schedules, including the reasons for this lack of progress.

children.title: Milestones
children.content: This section shall describe the progress made against program milestones during the reporting period.

children.title: Alternative Approaches
children.content: This section shall describe alternative approaches for any reused as-is/modified and COTS/GOTS software products that are 1) considered high or moderate risk or 2) not available (i.e., fully documented and tested) at contract award.  Alternative approaches provide options if these software reuse products cannot be implemented as planned.

children.title: Impacts of Implementing Alternative Approaches
children.content: This section shall include an assessment of the technical impacts to the program and estimates of the programmatic (i.e., effort and schedule) impacts of implementing alternative approaches.

children.title: Decision Points
children.content: This section shall include the decision points for implementing alternative approaches.  These decision points shall identify when the alternative approach would need to be implemented in the event that the planned software reuse products are not available in time to preserve the program schedule.

children.title: Worksheet Questions
children.content: This section shall include the completed forms (updated, if needed) for all reused as-is/modified and COTS/GOTS software products in accordance with the instructions embedded in the forms.  Forms will be included for any newly identified software reuse products.
